subject: only my opinion
author: drunknnumpty
body:
so which car looks best... not particularly bothered with the way the car looks, the handling and drifting of the car is more important.. if i wanted a game where i wanted nice looking cars then i would get PGR, Forza or NFS... whats the point of a 'pretty' car if it drives like excrement..

also not overly fussed about colours or choice of paint finishes, i was happy with the choice of 3 colours on Takedown and the expanded options of Revenge, as i said above if thats what i wanted i would get a different game..

also don't get why so many people are writing into the podcasts just to ask 'how many colours can you have', what a bunch of muppets, is the colour the most important thing, i think not.. get to grips with reality and think about what you really want..

i think we need a follow up poll once Paradise is released (somewhere is a galaxy far far away in the next century im sure) about which car handles the best to see which car is the ultimate Burnout car.... so far from all the Burnout versions i played its still the good ole' assassin super.. but that probably because its the car i have raced the most.. still prefer the drifting style over the Revenge Racer and would love to try the Assassin on the revenge tracks... that would be sweet, being about to port cars from previous versions of the game.. hmmm downloadable content maybe?? something to ask the creator about maybe...

 

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...
